system.description:
Favoured weapon: Sword, Broad

Granted power: Advantage on Perception. Your Aura of Courage (10ft before 2nd level) sheds dim moonlight, and once/day you can end the Blinded condition and magical darkness within it.

Allegiance: Chaotic Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Eilistraee in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: lead one soul out of the dark (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
